user.title: Connect to Virtual Carillon
user.description: Enter the URL of the Virtual Carillon API, the optional bearer token, and the LitCal settings.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the Virtual Carillon API.

abort.already_configured: This Virtual Carillon API is already configured.

init.title: Virtual Carillon schedules
init.description: Turn on Westminster once, then add manual or automatic schedules. Manual schedules play a selected asset or hymn; automatic schedules let LitCal choose the hymn. Each schedule can contain multiple times, selected days, a daily time window, and Home Assistant media players.

menu_options.add_routine: Add a manual or automatic schedule...

westminster.title: Westminster
westminster.description: Choose the cadence, days, daily time window, and Home Assistant speakers. Hour strikes automatically use the actual hour count.

add_routine.title: Choose schedule mode
add_routine.description: Manual plays one specific asset or hymn. Automatic uses LitCal and the hymn catalog to choose the best hymn for the date. Automatic is recommended for normal use.

add_routine_manual.title: Configure manual playback
add_routine_manual.description: Choose one specific asset or hymn, then set the time, days, and speakers.

data.asset: Specific asset or hymn (Manual mode only)
data.canonical_hour: Traditional Liturgy of the Hours preference (Automatic mode only)

add_routine_category.title: Configure category playback
add_routine_category.description: Choose one or more hymn categories, optionally prefer a canonical hour, then set the time, days, and speakers.

data.canonical_hour: Traditional Liturgy of the Hours preference

add_routine_automatic.title: Configure automatic playback
add_routine_automatic.description: LitCal will choose the hymn using the date's feast, season, and catalog metadata. Leave the hour at Default (recommended); select a canonical hour only when you specifically want traditional Liturgy of the Hours matching.

edit_routine_mode.title: Choose schedule mode
edit_routine_mode.description: Manual plays one specific asset or hymn. Automatic uses LitCal and the hymn catalog to choose the best hymn for the date. Automatic is recommended for normal use.

edit_routine_manual.title: Edit manual playback
edit_routine_manual.description: Change the selected asset or hymn, times, days, time window, or speakers.

data.asset: Specific asset or hymn (Manual mode only)
data.canonical_hour: Traditional Liturgy of the Hours preference (Automatic mode only)

edit_routine_category.title: Edit category playback
edit_routine_category.description: Change the selected hymn categories, canonical-hour preference, times, days, time window, or speakers.

data.canonical_hour: Traditional Liturgy of the Hours preference

edit_routine_automatic.title: Edit automatic playback
edit_routine_automatic.description: Automatic mode uses LitCal and the hymn catalog. Leave the hour at Default (recommended); select a canonical hour only for traditional Liturgy of the Hours matching.
